title: Weekend Strolls
tagline: Pick a combo. Or ask for a card.
askHint: AI drafts → you approve TikToks before live

pairing.label: Sat → Blok M food flex · Sun → Café → mall → Vietnam coffee

combos.title: Café work → mall → Vietnam coffee
combos.subtitle: Laptop morning, stroll afternoon, soft landing

stops.name: Dua Coffee Cipete
stops.note: Long table, plugs, and a quiet first 90 minutes before the mall pulse.

stops.name: Pondok Indah Mall
stops.note: Covered wander, people-watch, and a cool-down walk between cafés.

stops.name: Cộng Cà Phê PI
stops.note: Coconut coffee landing — sweet, slow, no laptop guilt.

combos.tip: Start the work block by 10:00 so the Vietnam coffee stop still feels like a landing, not another queue.
combos.rainNotes: Skip the outdoor terrace at Dua. PI is fully covered; Cộng is the indoor backup if Cipete streets flood.

combos.title: Blok M food flex
combos.subtitle: Seto → Obihiro → JDW dessert hop

stops.name: Seto Menchi Grill
stops.note: Menchi set first — sliding tamago only if the queue is moving.

stops.name: Obihiro Nikudon
stops.note: Queue is the feature. Grab a number, then wander Melawai 5 while you wait.

stops.name: JDW dessert hop
stops.note: Jakarta Dessert Week City Takeover — pick one dangdut-menu pastry, not three.

combos.tip: Ride MRT to Blok M. Do Obihiro before 11:30 or after 15:00 unless you want a two-hour line as the main event.
combos.rainNotes: Pasaraya and Melawai shophouses are mostly covered. If the alley floods, stay inside Pasaraya and swap Obihiro for a mall Japanese counter.

combos.title: Soft Sunday café loop
combos.subtitle: Anchor café → third place → Bansan/Presto

stops.name: Two Cents Cipete
stops.note: First latte, no agenda. Sit until the sun is less aggressive.

stops.name: Giyanti Coffee Roastery
stops.note: Walkable third place — paper, playlist, one pastry max.

stops.name: BANSAN / Ayam Presto
stops.note: Nanban bowl at BANSAN or classic ayam presto if you want home-style instead of café food.

combos.tip: This is a recovery loop, not a crawl. One drink per stop. Leave the laptop at home.
combos.rainNotes: Grab a Grab between Two Cents and Giyanti if Cipete Raya is ponding. Both BANSAN and Presto are indoor.

combos.title: PI rain bunker
combos.subtitle: Covered mall loop, cinema buffer, dessert if skies open

stops.name: Pondok Indah Mall 1–2
stops.note: Skybridge the whole loop. No street crossing required.

stops.name: Cinema XXI PI
stops.note: Matinee as rain insurance — two hours of AC while the sky empties.

stops.name: JDW pastry counter
stops.note: If the rain breaks, grab one City Takeover dessert to go. If not, eat it in the food court.

combos.tip: This is the wet-weekend swap for the Cipete loops. Park once. Do not add a Blok M hop.
combos.rainNotes: Built for rain. If PI parking is jammed, drop at the basement and stay inside until closing.
